description: This file contains helper methods for testing error handling and API call responses within the Fineract project, particularly for asserting successful or failed API responses and batch responses.

classes.name: ErrorHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist in verifying API call responses during testing.

methods.name: checkSuccessfulApiCall
methods.description: Asserts that the API response indicates success; throws an assertion error if unsuccessful or if the response code is not one of the expected successful codes.

methods.name: checkFailedApiCall
methods.description: Asserts that the API response indicates failure and the response code matches the expected failure code; throws an error otherwise.

methods.name: checkSuccessfulBatchApiCall
methods.description: Verifies each response in a batch API call is successful (status code 200).
